SPS H4 — campaign QA

Every sub_run of the July–August 2026 P2 BASKET beam test at the SPS H4 line: what each DAQ recorded, what has been processed, how the VMM and DREAM streams line up spill by spill, and the efficiency of the VMM-read stations against uRWELL tracks. Static page — the numbers come from vmm/matching/ on EOS, rebuilt with build_qa_data.py.

The campaign in one strip

One block per sub_run, in run order. Height is the number of DREAM events (log), colour is the state of the stream matching. Click a block to open it in the matching view.

matched ≥90% partial no lock no VMM data

What this page is showing

What exists on EOS for each sub_run. DREAM chunks are combined_hits_root files, VMM raw are pcapng captures and VMM store the decoded column store. Matched and Efficiency are the products this analysis adds.

The two DAQs run on independent clocks; every DREAM event is matched to its VMM trigger through a per-spill fit. The strip shows every spill of the sub_run — hover for the numbers, and for why an unmatched one failed.

matched partial no lock outside the VMM window gap in the VMM captures

efficiency = N(uRWELL track lands on the pads and a VMM pad fired within probe_r of it) / N(track lands on the pads), with Clopper-Pearson 68.27% intervals. The uRWELL reference is the same one the DREAM-read campaign used, so the two are directly comparable.
